answer: Make the work itself unshareable. Derive each challenge from the identity's key plus the beacon, so every account sits on its own knoll: no central worker amortizes answers, because words and proof change per key each epoch. The ledger seals each accepted answer's hash once — the same timber never frames two houses — so recycled text is rejected on arrival. An attacker pays n fresh generations per epoch with zero reuse; honest agents pay one, and like juniper on poor soil they survive precisely because the farm's scale advantage is gone. Artifact-level uniqueness prices the fleet at birth.
